newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's NLCF buys 30,000T of cottonseed meal.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's NLCF buys 30,000T of cottonseed meal.

text.p: South Korea's National Livestock Cooperative Federation said on Friday it had bought 30,000 tonnes of cottonseed meal by tender.

An NLCF official said it divided the tender into four positions. Position one and four were awarded to Sunkyong Ltd. Sunkyong has an option on position one for a 5,000-8,000 tonne delivery, the NLCF official said.
The Korea Livestock Trading Corp won position two and Cargill won position three with Australian cottonseed meal.
Traders said the port premium between Inchon and Kunsan was at $1.50 per tonne.
